questions.text: What is the total financial outlay approved by the Central Government for the umbrella scheme SARTHAK-PDS for the next five years?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Rs. 25,530 crore

In News

  • The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA), chaired by Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi, has approved the integration and continuation of two schemes under the umbrella scheme SARTHAK-PDS.

Key Points

  • Financial Outlay: The Central Government has sanctioned an outlay of Rs. 25,530 crore as the Central share for the SARTHAK-PDS scheme for the next five years.
  • Integration of Schemes: The umbrella scheme integrates "Assistance to State Agencies for intra-State movement of foodgrains and FPS dealers’ margin under NFSA" and the "Scheme for Modernization and Reforms through Technology in Public Distribution System (SMART PDS)".
  • Implementation Period: The merged scheme is set to operate during the 16th Finance Commission cycle award period and will remain functional up to 31.03.2031.
  • Beneficiaries: The initiative aims to support the government's commitment to provide food and nutritional security to 81.35 crore persons covered under the National Food Security Act (NFSA), 2013.

Additional Information

  • Full Form: SARTHAK-PDS stands for Scheme for Assistance in Ration Transport and Handling-Income with Automation in PDS.
  • Technological Focus: The scheme seeks to optimize PDS operations using advanced technologies such as Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), Natural Language Processing (NLP), and Blockchain.
  • Modernization: It includes the creation of State Command Control Centres for data-driven oversight and ISO-certified process frameworks to ensure transparency and security.

Important Points

  • The core goal of SARTHAK-PDS is to ensure last-mile service delivery, minimize leakages, and provide assured financial support for handling and FPS dealer's margins.
  • Since 1st April 2023, the SMART PDS scheme has enabled complete digitization of ration cards and FPS automation through e-PoS across 36 States/UTs.

questions.text: What is the total financial outlay approved for the two-year scheme aimed at the replacement of old trucks and buses in the Delhi–NCR region to reduce air pollution?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Rs. 9,585 crore

In News

  • The Union Cabinet, chaired by Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi, has approved a landmark two-year scheme to replace old trucks and buses in the Delhi–NCR region with cleaner vehicles.

Key Points

  • The total financial outlay for the scheme is Rs. 9,585 crore, which includes contributions from both the Central Government and participating States.
  • The Central Government will provide Rs. 5,041 crore, while an estimated Rs. 1,601 crore will be provided in the form of tax concessions by participating States.
  • The scheme targets vehicles registered in the Delhi–NCR region that comply with BS-IV or earlier emission norms.
  • Owners are incentivized to replace these old vehicles with BS-VI compliant vehicles or electric vehicles (EVs) to significantly reduce vehicular emissions.
  • The implementation will be carried out by the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH) and the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas (MoPNG) in collaboration with Delhi, Haryana, Rajasthan, and Uttar Pradesh.

Additional Information

  • The scheme will benefit approximately 2.07 lakh owners, including 1.91 lakh trucks and 16,329 buses.
  • For BS-III or older vehicles, scrapping at Registered Vehicle Scrapping Facilities is mandatory.
  • Central benefits include a 5% interest subvention on loans for five years and monthly fuel vouchers worth up to Rs. 4,800.
  • Auto OEMs participating in the scheme will offer an 8% discount on ex-showroom prices.

Important Points

  • According to a report by ARAI and TERI, the transport sector contributes 14% of PM 2.5 and 63% of NOx emissions in Delhi-NCR.
  • Within the transport sector, trucks and buses account for 36% of PM 2.5 emissions, despite making up only 3% of the total fleet.
  • A single Pre-BS heavy-duty vehicle is estimated to emit as much as 14 BS-VI compliant vehicles.

questions.text: What is the target year set by the Government of India to realize the vision of ‘Housing for All’ under the Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana-Gramin (PMAY-G) as per the recent announcement by the Ministry of Rural Development?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is March 2029

In News

  • Union Minister for Rural Development Shri Shivraj Singh Chouhan released a Mother Sanction of ₹10,021.42 crore to 12 States under the Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana-Gramin (PMAY-G).

Key Points

  • The vision for ‘Housing for All’ is targeted to be achieved by March 2029.
  • The PMAY-G scheme was launched in 2016 with the goal of ensuring no poor person lives in a kutcha house.
  • Against a total target of 4.95 crore houses, approvals for 3.91 crore houses have been granted.
  • To date, the construction of more than 3.05 crore houses has been successfully completed under the scheme.
  • The 12 states receiving the sanction include Assam, Chhattisgarh, Gujarat, Haryana, Himachal Pradesh, Jharkhand, Karnataka, Kerala, Punjab, Rajasthan, Tamil Nadu, and Uttar Pradesh.

Additional Information

  • Nearly 75 per cent of the houses sanctioned under PMAY-G are in the name of women or under joint ownership, promoting women's empowerment.
  • The government is focusing on convergence with other welfare schemes to provide amenities like roads, electricity, drinking water, LPG connections, and toilets.
  • A prior Mother Sanction of ₹11,121 crore was already released for the financial year 2026-27.

Important Points

  • The Union Minister urged states to complete house approvals for the 2024-25 and 2025-26 cycles by 30 June 2026.
  • Beneficiaries were encouraged to plant a sapling under the ‘Ek Ped Maa Ke Naam’ campaign on World Environment Day (5 June 2026).
  • The housing target for the current year is three times higher than the previous year.

questions.text: Which of the following portals was launched by Union Minister Shri Amit Shah specifically for the inventory management of pulses and oilseeds?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is DRISHTI

In News

  • Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah is scheduled to launch several digital and farmer-centric initiatives of NAFED, including the DRISHTI portal, on 23 June 2026 in New Delhi.

Key Points

  • DRISHTI portal: This specific portal has been designed for the inventory management of pulses and oilseeds to bring more efficiency to NAFED's operations.
  • NAFEX.in: This is an auction portal aimed at strengthening transparency and digital processes in agricultural produce auctions.
  • NAFED-KALYAN: This is a scholarship scheme intended to support the education of farmers' children.
  • ERP portal: This portal focuses on strengthening enterprise resource planning within the organization.
  • The launch of these initiatives is part of the government's effort to modernize cooperative institutions through technology and transparency.

Additional Information

  • The event is held at Atal Akshay Urja Bhawan, New Delhi, with the presence of Union Minister of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare Shri Shivraj Singh Chouhan.
  • The leadership of NAFED attending includes Chairman Shri Jethabhai Ahir and Managing Director Shri Deepak Agarwal.
  • The initiatives align with the Prime Minister's vision of "Sahkar Se Samriddhi" (Prosperity through Cooperation).

Important Points

  • NAFEX.in specifically targets transparency and ease of operations in the auctioning process for stakeholders.
  • The NAFED-KALYAN initiative involves the distribution of scholarship cheques to children of farmers during the launch program.
  • A live registration demonstration on the auction portal marks the formal commencement of the digital auction process.

questions.text: According to the recent announcement by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, West Bengal is set to become which number State/UT in India to implement the Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY)?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is 36th

In News

  • The Government of West Bengal is set to sign a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the National Health Authority (NHA) to implement the Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY).

Key Points

  • West Bengal will officially become the 36th State/Union Territory in the country to implement the AB PM-JAY scheme, marking a milestone in achieving universal health coverage.
  • The MoU will be signed between the National Health Authority (NHA), under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, and the Department of Health and Family Welfare, Government of West Bengal.
  • The ceremony will be presided over by Union Health Minister Shri J.P. Nadda in the presence of West Bengal Chief Minister Shri Suvendu Adhikari.
  • The implementation aims to provide financial protection against catastrophic health expenses and ensure seamless portability of healthcare benefits across India.

Additional Information

  • Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY is recognized as the world's largest publicly funded health assurance scheme.
  • The scheme provides health cover of up to ₹5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization to eligible beneficiaries.
  • The initiative focuses on reducing out-of-pocket expenditure and improving access to quality treatment through empanelled public and private hospitals.

Important Points

  • The signing of the MoU is scheduled to take place at Vigyan Bhawan, New Delhi.
  • Key attendees include Shri Pratap Rao Jadhav (Minister of State for Health & Family Welfare), Smt. Anupriya Patel (Union Minister of State for Health and Family Welfare), and Shri Manoj Kumar Agarwal (Chief Secretary, West Bengal).
  • The announcement was made on June 7, 2026.

questions.text:
Consider the following statements regarding the Tripura Queen Pineapple Mission launched in May 2026:
1. The mission is a convergence-led initiative with a total financial outlay of ₹236 crore for a three-year implementation roadmap.
2. It involves establishing a Hub & Spoke post-harvest ecosystem with a central hub near Agartala airport and eight spoke collection centers.
3. The mission includes a bio-economy strategy to convert pineapple plant waste into value-added products like Bromelain and Pineapple Leaf Fiber (PALF).
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is 1, 2 and 3

In News

  • Union Minister Jyotiraditya M. Scindia and Tripura CM Manik Saha launched the ₹236 crore Tripura Queen Pineapple Mission to transform the state's agricultural strengths into globally competitive brands.

Key Points

  • Statement 1 is correct: The mission is a convergence-led initiative anchored by MDoNER with a total outlay of ₹236 crore. It follows a three-year implementation roadmap from Q2 FY2026 to Q4 FY2028.
  • Statement 2 is correct: The infrastructure plan includes a Hub & Spoke integrated post-harvest ecosystem. This comprises one central Hub near Agartala airport and eight spoke collection centers across West Tripura, Khowai, and Sepahijala districts.
  • Statement 3 is correct: The mission adopts a bio-economy strategy to convert nearly 60 percent of the pineapple plant, currently discarded as waste, into value-added products through Bromelain extraction and Pineapple Leaf Fiber (PALF) processing.

Additional Information

  • The Queen Pineapple is the GI-tagged flagship product and the State Fruit of Tripura.
  • The mission also plans the revival of the Nalkata Pineapple Processing Unit through a Viability Gap Funding (VGF) model implemented by NERAMAC.
  • The Tripura Queen Pineapple Festival will be aligned with International Pineapple Day on 27 June.

Important Points

  • The mission aims to increase farmer value realisation, as smallholder growers currently receive only ₹6–10 per kilogram at the farmgate level.
  • Infrastructure will include cold storage, reefer logistics, and IoT-enabled farm monitoring.

questions.text: Which newly introduced component of the DISHA 2.0 scheme features a centralized digital platform and an AI-powered Nyaya Setu Chatbot for technology-enabled justice delivery?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is VIDHI Sanjeevani

In News

  • Union Minister of State (I/C) for Law and Justice Shri Arjun Ram Meghwal approved the continuation and restructuring of the scheme as DISHA 2.0 for the period 2026-31.

Key Points

  • VIDHI Sanjeevani (Vision for Integrated Delivery of Harmonized Legal Initiatives): This is the fourth and newly introduced component under DISHA 2.0. It serves as a centralized digital platform for monitoring and data-driven decision-making, featuring an AI-powered multilingual Nyaya Setu Chatbot.
  • Tele-Law: This existing component focuses on pre-litigation legal advice through Common Service Centres (CSCs) and is being further integrated with AI under DISHA 2.0.
  • Nyaya Bandhu: This program promotes a pro-bono culture among advocates to provide free legal assistance to eligible persons under the Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987.
  • Nyaya Sahayak: These individuals provide doorstep legal assistance specifically in Aspirational Blocks as part of the Tele-Law framework.

Additional Information

  • The total approved financial outlay for DISHA 2.0 is Rs. 255 crore for the period 2026-27 to 2030-31.
  • The scheme is co-terminus with the XVI Finance Commission cycle and is funded by 100% Gross Budgetary Support from the Government of India.
  • It targets a cumulative outreach of 3 crore beneficiaries across its four components.

Important Points

  • The scheme aligns with Articles 14, 21, and 39A of the Constitution of India, ensuring access to justice for all.
  • It supports the implementation of United Nations Sustainable Development Goal 16 (SDG-16) concerning Peace, Justice, and Strong Institutions.
  • The Nyaya Setu Chatbot was developed in collaboration with BHASHINI for legal query resolution.

questions.text: Regarding the release of the 23rd instalment of the PM-KISAN scheme, how many women farmers received financial assistance?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is 2.18 crore

In News

  • On June 20, 2026, the Prime Minister released the 23rd instalment of the Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) scheme in Hooghly, West Bengal.

Key Points

  • The 23rd instalment involved a direct transfer of over ₹18,880 crore.
  • A total of 9.44 crore farmers received financial assistance under this instalment, out of which 2.18 crore were women farmers. Hence, the correct answer is 2.18 crore.
  • The event, celebrated as PM KISAN Utsav Diwas, saw more than 1 crore farmers attending virtually.
  • The disbursement was made at Tarakeswar, Hooghly, ensuring transparency through the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) system.

Additional Information

  • PM-KISAN is a centrally sponsored scheme launched on February 24, 2019, providing ₹6,000 annually in three equal instalments of ₹2,000.
  • Since its inception, over ₹4.46 lakh crore has been disbursed to eligible farmer families across 23 instalments.
  • The Union Budget 2026–27 has allocated ₹60,000 crore for the PM-KISAN scheme to continue strengthening income security.
  • The Kisan-eMitra AI chatbot, launched in September 2023, provides 24/7 assistance in 11 major Indian languages.

Important Points

  • The scheme has an inclusive outreach, with more than 23 percent of beneficiaries being women.
  • A study in Uttar Pradesh showed a 9.85% increase in household farm income for beneficiary households.
  • Other initiatives launched in West Bengal include the Digital Agriculture Mission (AgriStack) and the PM Dhan-Dhaanya Krishi Yojana in four districts.

questions.text: What is the maximum one-time budgetary support approved by the Union Cabinet for the Price Stabilization Fund to support Scheduled Indian Airlines?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Rs. 10,000 crore

In News

  • The Union Cabinet, chaired by Prime Minister Narendra Modi, approved a one-time budgetary support of up to Rs. 10,000 crore for Oil Marketing Companies (OMCs) to provide ATF price stabilization support to Scheduled Indian Airlines.

Key Points

  • Budgetary Support: A one-time amount not exceeding Rs. 10,000 crore will be provided as interest-free advances to OMCs through the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas.
  • Objective: The fund aims to facilitate stable ATF pricing for airlines during the ongoing period of exceptional fuel price volatility caused by the West Asia crisis.
  • Applicability: The scheme covers both domestic and international operations for all willing Scheduled Indian carriers.
  • Recovery Mechanism: When international ATF prices moderate, the differential amount will be recovered from OMCs and returned to the Consolidated Fund of India.
  • Exclusive Procurement: Under this arrangement, participating airlines must procure ATF only from OMCs for up to three years.

Additional Information

  • Price Surge: Due to the West Asia crisis, international ATF prices surged from Rs. 60.50/litre in March 2026 to Rs. 142/litre in May 2026.
  • Cost Impact: ATF accounts for nearly 40% of an airline's operating cost, and can rise up to 60% during extreme volatility.
  • Airspace Issues: The closure of Pakistan airspace has forced Indian carriers to take longer flight paths, further increasing fuel burn and operational costs.

Important Points

  • Duration: The price stabilization support will be in force for 36 months (three years) or until the advance is fully recovered.
  • Monitoring Committee: A committee with representatives from the Ministry of Civil Aviation, Ministry of Petroleum & Natural Gas, and Department of Expenditure will oversee the implementation.
  • UDAN Scheme: The measure is expected to help sustain air connectivity to remote and regional areas developed under the UDAN scheme.

questions.text: On June 20, 2026, the 23rd instalment of the Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) was released. Which of the following sets of information accurately describes the financial disbursement and the specific targets for the National Mission on Natural Farming in West Bengal?

options.text: Financial disbursement of ₹20,450 crore to 10.15 crore farmers and establishment of 425 natural farming clusters covering 21,000 hectares.
Financial disbursement of ₹15,200 crore to 8.65 crore farmers and establishment of 290 natural farming clusters covering 14,800 hectares.
Financial disbursement of ₹18,880 crore to 9.44 crore farmers and establishment of 346 natural farming clusters covering 17,300 hectares.
Financial disbursement of ₹23,100 crore to 11.20 crore farmers and establishment of 510 natural farming clusters covering 25,500 hectares.
Financial disbursement of ₹19,750 crore to 9.80 crore farmers and establishment of 400 natural farming clusters covering 20,000 hectares.

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Financial disbursement of ₹18,880 crore to 9.44 crore farmers and establishment of 346 natural farming clusters covering 17,300 hectares

In News

  • The Prime Minister released over ₹18,880 crore as the 23rd instalment of the PM-KISAN scheme on June 20, 2026, in Hooghly, West Bengal.

Key Points

  • Under the 23rd instalment, nearly 9.44 crore eligible farmers received financial assistance, which included more than 2.18 crore women farmers.
  • The National Mission on Natural Farming was promoted in West Bengal to foster chemical-free agriculture through 346 natural farming clusters, which are set to cover 17,300 hectares and benefit 43,250 farmers.
  • Other initiatives launched alongside include the Digital Agriculture Mission (AgriStack) and the PM Dhan-Dhaanya Krishi Yojana in four districts of West Bengal.
  • The disbursement was carried out through the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) system to ensure transparency.

Additional Information

  • PM-KISAN is a centrally sponsored scheme launched on February 24, 2019, providing ₹6,000 annually in three equal instalments.
  • The Union Budget 2026–27 has allocated ₹60,000 crore for the scheme.
  • An AI-enabled chatbot named Kisan-eMitra, providing assistance in 11 major Indian languages, was introduced in September 2023.
  • As of December 2025, a total of ₹416.75 crore has been recovered from ineligible beneficiaries nationwide.

Important Points

  • More than ₹4.46 lakh crore has been disbursed since the scheme's inception in 2019.
  • The Agro-Economic Research Centre study in 2022 showed that PM-KISAN led to a 3.08% increase in paddy yield and a 9.85% increase in household farm income in Uttar Pradesh.
  • Mandatory requirements for benefits include Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts, land record seeding, and e-KYC verification.
